regressions.claim: The scored population is the truth's: c17 (yes) alone; the 18 other undocumented entries and the excluded c13 are not scored. The builder read the truth's l10 field before this prereg to list it.

design.C0_population: the scored entries are those of spec/M5/truth/corpus.json (at truth_sha256) whose l10 is yes or no, less spec/M5/lib/truth_protocol.json known_exclusions (c13): listed in scored. An undocumented entry (no truth item, a disagreement included: Q3 of the protocol) is never scored, never adjudicated and never re-labelled
design.C1_scope: an entry's scope is its files (spec/eval/corpus.json entries[].files) at its prefix_commit, read through git in the checkout spec/M5/lib/intent_corpus_sources.json names for its repo; a missing checkout or file fails, never skips
design.C2_lane: I55's lane, unchanged: holon.intent.atomize.atoms_of (repo = the entry's repo URL, commit = prefix_commit), holon.intent.compile's templates and binding, holon.intent.model and holon.intent.run. Extraction checks the checkout out at prefix_commit (outside this repository) only when an atom matches a template. Laws compiled from corpus atoms go to laws/INTENT/corpus/ and their generated files to gen/M5/intent/corpus/, never into I55's laws/INTENT/ set
design.C3_review: a compiled corpus law can be an obstruction only after a review under I55's design V (one fresh reviewer, recorded verbatim under spec/M5/intent/); with no compiled law there is no review
design.C4_truth_blind: `python -m holon intent corpus [--check]` reads the key, spec/eval/corpus.json, the sources sidecar and the checkouts; never spec/M5/truth/ or the census. Only `python -m holon intent corpus-score [--check]` reads the truth file, at its pinned sha256
design.C5_score: an entry is obstructed iff one of its laws is REFUTED and passes W1 and W2. corpus_recall = proportion(obstructed scored yes entries, scored yes entries) (I54 common.proportion), labelled by min_n (I54 common.labels): a measure with denominator 1..4 is insufficient_n and is never judged meets. results/M5/intent/corpus/l10_corpus.json: {truth_sha256, corpus_sha256, entries: {id: {l10, atoms, compiled, obstructions}}, corpus_recall, label}
design.doc: How I55's lane runs on the corpus and how corpus_recall is scored. Fixed before any corpus record; tests_m5/test_m5_intent_corpus.py checks each rule.
